sources.title: ProCreations/K2-Horizon-7B-Uno-NVFP4 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Community NVFP4 W4A4 conversion of IFM/K2-Horizon-7B, bundled with the unchanged BF16 Uno conditional diffusion adapter and a tested, single-GPU Blackwell runtime. The root contains the packed base model. adapter/ contains the original conditional adapter, loaded separately and enabled only on Uno's diffusion pathway.
